text:
maya: Quick sync — Product wants requester name in export notifications. Privacy/legal flagged this could leak via email archives. Thoughts?
ethan: Strong no on raw display names in outbound notifs. Presigned links get forwarded.
priya: Product use-case: compliance ops want to triage from the toast. Can we show non-PII context?
jordi: Suggestion: use actor_label (e.g., "Team admin" or "Requester: alias_x1") in notif; full actor info only on the console download page after entitlement check. No presign in notif.
legal: Confirmed: any info that leaves our system and lands in customer inboxes should be non-identifying. Hashed alias OK.
maya: Telemetry needs to surface who requested for dashboards. We'll emit export.requested with actor_hash and tenant_id. UI to show human-friendly label only to users with audit:view.
ethan: API flow: POST /exports -> returns { export_id, status, actor_label, download_token } (no presign_url). Client GET /exports/:id/presign?token=... after entitlement validated server-side.
priya: UX: Toast text: "Export queued (requested by a team member). View Audit > Exports for details." Hover/details show real name only if entitlement present.
jordi: Quota: debounce duplicate clicks (30s), concurrent_per_tenant=2, plus optional enterprise burst tokens. Emit export.duplicate_clicks metric.
audit-bot: SYSTEM: export.requested emitted (export_id=e-9001, actor_hash=ah_b7, tenant=t-91, bucket_estimate=~1k)
maya: Action items: ethan implement download_token/presign exchange (2d); jordi add quota + debounce + telemetry (3d); priya draft copy + admin toggle for notif verbosity (1d); legal to sign off email templates (2d). Canary to 5% tenants.
priya: I'll prepare examples for internal channels where admins can opt-in to show exact counts.
ethan: Also add X-Export-Quota-Remaining header in API responses.
maya: Good. Keep notifications minimal by default and gate reveal via entitlement. We'll reconvene after canary metrics (error-rate, dup_clicks, notif_spam). :white_check_mark:
